title: openai-image-gen/prompt-generator output
description: Output of the prompt submission tool: the normalized prompt, its mode and the composition. The tool also emits the fixed openai-image.generate.requested event as an effect, so the model never builds the event envelope itself.

prompt.description: Normalized final image prompt. Structured prompts are serialized by the submission tool.

promptMode.description: Output style. text=natural-language prompt; image-json=structured JSON serialized as a string.

composition.description: Picture composition mode copied from runtime settings and forwarded for tracing.
